column1: # Per-slide speaking budget for talk v2.
# Target is 41:00 planned against a 45:00 slot — four minutes of real slack
# before touching the three borrowable from Q&A. Caps are converted to word
# counts by tools/talk-timing.py at the configured speaking rate; demo slides
# are scored at a lower rate because you talk more slowly around typing.
# Rate calibrated 2026-08-17 against a real read-through: 547 words in 3:05
# including navigation = 177 wpm. Planning rate is 130 (that measurement minus
# ~25% for live delivery). Everything below is sized at 130.
# Only slides currently in deck.typ are listed. Rows are added as v2 slides
# ── Act 0 · Open — 5:00 · VERBATIM SCRIPT (the part that gets stumbled)
# 02-alice also carries the payment-domain framing, without which the domain
# vocabulary in the four bugs lands before the audience has anywhere to put it.
# Caps are set to what the written script actually measures at 130 wpm, not
# trimmed to hit a target — MB's own read came in at 3:05 for the earlier
# version, so there is real headroom between this planning figure and the room.
# ── Act 1 · History braided into the primer — 8:30
